During their [[Chubbit resistance|resistance]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] claiming to be [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;but actually an [[Obi-Wan Kenobi impersonator|impersonator]] working for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]&mdash;'''attacked''' and destroyed an [[Aridus Imperial outpost|Imperial outpost]]. The assault was orchestrated by Vader to lend credibility to the actor's claims to be Kenobi, a trap intended to draw in Kenobi's former apprentice, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="CSW10" />
